name: balance_two_legs
title: Balance on two legs (hold + reject external pushes)
summary: The deterministic two-leg stand: a stiff, statically-stable squat held by a Newton position PD, kept centred by a reactive ankle lean + a fast arm-swing balancer + a hip return-to-home integral. Robust to external pushes -- the reference demo throws DEF CUBE0..n at the torso one at a time from every side and the robot keeps standing (the cube-defense demo). This is the balance CORE every other humanoid posture/arm skill rides on top of.
owns_effectors: whole body (the balance core; other skills overlay on top of it)
balance_by: stiff statically-stable squat (Newton position hold, ank_bias centred)
reactive ankle lean (disturbance-driven, catches a push)
arm_balance: shoulder swing as a fast CoM-shift + counter-rotation effector (kp=6)

verification.result: G1 stands robustly (0 falls over 400 s+ sim) and holds all thrown cubes, returning pitch & roll to ~0; runs robust COLD. H1 also stands via the same generic harness (per-robot specs). See docs/developer/humanoid-deterministic-stand.md and docs/developer/rl-current-state.md.
verification.note: This run ALSO covered a NASA Valkyrie, which is why older copies of this manifest and its README said 'G1, H1, Valkyrie'. That robot package was removed from the tree in be41986f8 -- it had no valid grant (its LICENSE.upstream was a blank NOSA template that never named the agency) -- and specs/valkyrie.json went with it. The 2026-06-27 measurement is not retracted; the robot is simply no longer here, so the skill is no longer offered for it. The machine-readable `robots` field has always read [g1, h1] and is unchanged.

related: arm_motion (move the arms in 3-D while balancing)
